fixed: 1. Pad disconnect: before, every disconnect paused the race and Input.action_release cleared steering, throttle and brake for every device, including a key the player was holding (checked: throttle 1.0 -> 0.0 with Up still held). Now InputSetup reports a disconnect with whether the pad was in use (new signal pad_disconnected, decided by InputMode.pad_lost before the mode changes). The race only pauses if it was the active pad or still held a button, stick or trigger above 0.2. The race no longer releases anything itself: Godot 4.7.2 already removes only that pad's input state on disconnect (checked in the engine source).

2. Title: TitleScreen.remembered_choice keeps only Einzelne Etappe, Bestenlisten and Optionen (2-4); any other entry resets the memory to -1. After a cancelled quit question, a rebuilt title (e.g. after a demo) is back on its default entry instead of 'Beenden'. Also covered by the 'beenden' check.

3. Footers of Einzelne Etappe and Bestenlisten: keyboard 'Bild↑ Bild↓ LB RB Seite', gamepad 'LB RB Seite' (static footer_hints() on both screens). The fonts and their fallbacks have no ↑/↓ glyphs, so the suggested text keycaps would render as missing-glyph boxes; I added keycaps 'pgup'/'pgdn' to KeyHints that draw the arrow. Width with keyboard 822 / 670 px, with gamepad 594 / 492 px of 1152 px; screenshots at 1280x720 and 1280x800 in both modes show no overlap. Unit test checks the widths and that PageUp/PageDown are bound.

4. Settings: to_dict() writes settings_version 2. For files without a version only a stored fullscreen true counts as the player's choice; a false is treated as not chosen (Settings.fullscreen_stored_as_choice). v2 files keep the new 'chosen' logic. Unit test with v0.5.1-style and v2 files. Corrected the sentences in docs/steam-deck.md (table row and the docked paragraph) and the wrong 'older files count as chosen' sentence in docs/ui.md.

5. Steering: the left stick is no longer bound to steer_left/steer_right (keys and D-pad stay there and steer fully). The race reads Input.get_joy_axis(InputMode.device, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X) through the existing curve (race_session.gd player_steer, SessionRules.pad_steer: per direction the stronger value, identical to before with one pad). InputMode.device follows the pad used last, also mid-race. Before: a 0.16 drift on a second pad steered 0.05; now 0. Unit test with real Input state on two devices (one drifting) plus the 'drift' integration check (switch to pad 0 gives -1.0, back to pad 1 gives 0.6). The autopilot and the Input.action_press movie/shot tools are unaffected.

6. Re-rendered the on-screen keyboard and all other after shots from the final code with the existing probe into deck060/shots/; the empty field now shows 'A Tippen, B Schließen, Start Fertig'. Rebuilt the before/after overview at deck060/overview.png, including a strip showing that the keyboard hints follow the focus.

7. track.gd: the doc line is back on events_for_segment(). The Optionen description now reads 'Lautstärke, Vollbild, Vibration, Spielername und Steuerung.' (wraps to two lines inside the card). The player car is preloaded again unconditionally, as in v0.5.1, so --no-sprite-preload keeps it; renn-modul.md notes this.

I checked the engine claim. core/input/input.cpp of tag 4.7.2-stable, fetched from GitHub, is byte-identical to the worker's copy. On disconnect, Input::joy_connection_changed removes only that pad's device state and recomputes the action cache. InputEventKey uses DEVICE_ID_KEYBOARD = 16 (input_event.cpp), so a held key never sits in a pad's state. action_release clears every device's state, which confirms that the old code also released the keyboard. On Linux, Godot 4.7.2 reads pads through SDL, so motion sensors do not show up as extra pads.

Race probe in a real race scene (probes/probe_race.gd, events through Input.parse_input_event): pad 0 drifting at 0.16 while pad 1 is active gives steering 0.000. Pad 1's stick at 0.5 gives 0.475 and at -0.3 gives -0.225, so the drift no longer weakens a small correction. Switching mid-race works: a -0.8 push on pad 0 makes it the active pad (steering -0.85), and RT 0.7 on pad 1 switches back (steering 0). Disconnecting idle pad 0 while pad 1 drives does not pause; disconnecting active pad 1 pauses. A keyboard player holding Up whose idle pad disconnects gets no pause and keeps throttle 1.00.

Title probe with real attract demos (probes/probe_title.gd): Optionen, then back, focuses Optionen again. 'Beenden' asks first; cancelling with B on the pad or with Esc sets title_choice to -1. After a demo that ends on its own, the rebuilt title focuses 'Rennen starten', not 'Beenden'. Bestenlisten stays remembered across a demo, as designed.

On 681ffed an old false was a chosen window everywhere. Saving a name over an old false file while docked writes a v2 file without 'fullscreen', and the next start at 1280x800 is full screen. The actual window mode cannot be observed because Xvfb has no window manager.

issues.problem: A keyboard player whose only or first pad lies around unused still steers with that pad's drift. player_steer reads Input.get_joy_axis(InputMode.device, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X) whether or not that pad was ever used, and InputSetup._ready makes the first connected pad the steering pad. The same happens after the active pad disconnects: the first remaining pad, possibly an idle drifting one, becomes the steering pad. This is the same case as finding 5 with one pad instead of two. It behaved the same before the commit (not a regression), and the docs only promise the fix for a second pad.
issues.evidence: probe_race.gd scenario A, keyboard holding Up, pad 0 at 0.16, no pad button ever pressed: steer=0.0500 with gamepad=false, device=0. With two pads (scenario B) the result is 0.0000.
issues.fix: Read the stick only from a pad used since it connected: InputMode.note() sets a per-device 'used' flag on a button press or a push of at least AXIS_THRESHOLD, and connect/disconnect clear it. player_steer then reads 0 for an unused pad (for example via an InputMode.stick_device() that returns -1). Add a unit test (keyboard plus one drifting pad gives 0) and a sentence in ui.md.

issues.problem: When a pad connects, InputSetup._on_joy_connection_changed sets InputMode.gamepad = true while InputMode.device still names that pad. A keyboard player's wireless pad that drops, reconnects by itself (for example Bluetooth flapping) and drops again before the next fresh key press therefore counts as the active pad, and the race pauses although the keyboard is driving. A held key sends only echo events, which do not switch back. This is still better than before the commit, when every drop paused.
issues.evidence: probe_race.gd scenario F, device 0, Up held: first drop gives paused=false; reconnect gives gamepad=true; second drop gives paused=true while throttle is still 1.00.
issues.fix: Count a pad as active in pad_lost only if it was used since it connected (the same per-device flag as in the first issue), or do not switch to gamepad mode on a connect once a key has been used. Extend the 'trennen' check with a connect followed by a disconnect.

issues.problem: The migration works as requested, but players are not told about its visible effect. An old file's 'Vollbild: Aus' no longer counts, so players who deliberately chose a window in v0.5.x will start in full screen once after updating if full screen is their start value. That covers screens up to 800 px high (1366x768 laptops, Windows at 150/200 % scaling, Steam Deck desktop mode). ui.md describes the rule, but docs/windows.md and the worker's README notes for v0.6.0 do not mention this one-time switch.
issues.evidence: Settings matrix at 1280x800 with an old {"fullscreen": false}: 9490c9b gives fullscreen=true, chosen=false; 681ffed gave false, chosen. docs/windows.md lines 82-90 are unchanged.
issues.fix: For the lead: one line in the v0.6.0 'Neu in' section of the README (whoever had switched 'Vollbild' off in v0.5.x switches it off once more). Optionally the same sentence in docs/windows.md.
